# Collect secure-mail telemetry after crypto processing completes

Current secureMailLoaded records from smimeprocessed on window and openpgpprocessed on document. Each handler reads the complete signed and encrypted state, ignores a message with neither state, then dispatches SecureMailLoaded for consumers. Generic MsgLoaded is too early for asynchronous signature verification. The 2024 migration used a first-read gate and separate signed/encrypted keys; later accepted code supersedes both. Only the relevant later file changes and current tests were read; their later bugs and reviews remain for their chronological batches. This study did not measure live event ordering.

Scope: Crypto processing and telemetry.
